description: This file defines the interface for the cl_ltp module, including data structures, function prototypes, and macros related to Long-Term Prediction (LTP) in speech codec processing, specifically for AMR speech codec implementation.

methods.name: cl_ltp_init
methods.description: Initializes an instance of the clLtpState structure, returning 0 on success.

methods.name: cl_ltp_reset
methods.description: Resets the clLtpState structure to zero, returning 0 on success.

methods.name: cl_ltp_exit
methods.description: De-initializes the clLtpState structure, freeing resources and setting pointer to NULL.

methods.name: cl_ltp
methods.description: Performs long-term prediction processing using provided state, mode, and signal vectors.
